reviewer: Codex; Gemini performs actual independent review

authorization.scope: Implement, verify and deploy J386 to the named project. Affiliate activation authorized per provider after real authentication and attributed-link validation. No additional Chairman approval needed within this scope.

baseline.verification: Re-resolve alias before mutation; previous HTTP follow-up timed out.

requirements: Remove arbitrary URL probing. Accept only strict JSON {itemId:string}, reject url/unknown fields and unknown IDs before any outbound request.

Resolve itemId against a server-owned audited catalogue. HTTPS only, exact allowed hostnames and port 443, no credentials. Validate all DNS A/AAAA results and pin the validated public address to the connection to prevent DNS rebinding. Deny private, loopback, link-local, reserved and IPv4-mapped private IPv6 destinations.
Disable redirects, or revalidate each bounded hop with identical host/DNS/IP controls. A redirect is not evidence of SKU availability.

Public readers receive stored status only; authenticated worker performs outbound requests. Secrets stay server-side; rate limits and bounded concurrency, time/body size/cache limits apply. Sanitized errors only.

Implement durable scheduler/shared observations for a 60s target if infrastructure exists. Otherwise label actual freshness, stale/UNKNOWN explicitly and do not assert a 60s guarantee. Root HTTP200 is not stock evidence.

Test rejection paths with mocked DNS/transport: arbitrary URL, unknown ID, internal IPv4/IPv6, mixed DNS, rebinding, redirects, timeout, 403/429, stale data. Assert blocked input produces zero outbound requests.

Check rejected M2 deployment URL exposure independently: removing canonical alias does not isolate an immutable deployment URL. Inventory exact aliases/access; protect or retire only that vulnerable deployment after preserving forensic artifacts. Preserve M1 rollback.
Acquire 30 real product photographs mapped to exact product/variant from official merchant sources with usable rights. Record source, rights basis, local asset path, SHA256, dimensions and alt text.

No empty gray cards, unrelated photos, error screenshots or illustration falsely labeled product photography. An item awaiting real media must be reported as pending; publish ready items without blocking unrelated modules.
Validate actual destination SKU, variant, merchant Mall status, observed price/time and delivery terms using raw artifacts. Existing M2 JSON labels alone are not evidence.
Show 'ĐÁY 30 NGÀY - RẺ HƠN XX%' only with sufficient authentic dated coverage and an explicit comparable reference price. Otherwise show truthful observed price/date; never synthesize history.

Activate provider-specific affiliate links when JayT credentials and attribution pass actual provider tests. Record redacted receipts. Unready providers retain useful official outbound links with accurate disclosure. Clicks are not revenue.
Dock immediately below Hero: Bách Khoa / Sư Phạm, Kinh Tế DUE, Duy Tân / Hải Châu, Sơn Trà.

Filter food <=35000 VND and <=1000m from documented campus anchors using verified branch coordinates. Label straight-line distance as such; do not imply walking-route distance. Missing coordinates remain unverified.

Render 3 comparable columns ShopeeFood, GrabFood, Xanh SM with synchronized accessible slider and integer VND totals, discounts/caps/delivery inputs. Label estimates/user-entered quotations when live prices unavailable.
Measure input-to-render p50/p95/max on declared device; target <30ms. Include boundary, empty-state and keyboard tests.
Add 'Lập Kèo Rủ Bạn (Zalo Pass)' to every eligible F&B/cinema card.
Generate local Canvas PNG with offer identity, source price, participant count and sum-preserving integer VND allocation. Require or reuse an explicit participant count; no invented per-person price.
Use same-origin/CORS-safe assets, test decoded PNG content and download/share fallback. Native share only on user gesture; never automatically message contacts. No PII/GPS in analytics or URLs.

release_gate: Security tests pass and vulnerable old deployment access is addressed with recorded evidence.
Verify 1440/768/390: image decode and correct SKU association, no blank cards/overflow/runtime errors; campus/comparator/PNG interactions.
Bind candidate hashes to live assets; HTTP200 / /registry.json /deals_feed.json; safe API rejects arbitrary URL without outbound requests.
Record actual Gemini review against deployment/hash; never generate a proxy Gemini PASS.

reporting.ack: Record actual start/ACK. ISSUED is not proof of delivery or execution.
reporting.deadline: Report actual completion time or missed deadline; never backdate.
reporting.completion: Report ready product count and remaining evidence/infrastructure dependencies; continue independent UI work.
reporting.rollback: Verify M1 recovery target before release; restore on critical regression and verify HTTP. Preserve sealed evidence.
